messages.text: Antonelli to miss Mexico media day with viral illness

metadata.summary: Kimi Antonelli will miss Thursday's media day at the Mexico City Grand Prix due to a viral illness ahead of the weekend when he will likely become Formula 1 world champion.
metadata.content: Kimi Antonelli to miss Mexico City GP media day due to viral illness ahead of likely world championship coronation | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Kimi Antonelli to miss Mexico City GP media day due to viral illness ahead of likely world championship coronation Championship leader Kimi Antonelli is recovering from a viral illness ahead of the weekend where he is expected to secure the Drivers' Championship; watch every session of the Mexico City GP with Friday's practice sessions at 6.30pm and 10pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Thursday 29 October 2026 17:32, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player On The F1 Show podcast, Ant Davidson explains how Kimi Antonelli stays grounded as he closes in on a world title Kimi Antonelli will miss Thursday's media day at the Mexico City Grand Prix due to a viral illness ahead of the weekend when he will likely become Formula 1 world champion. A top-nine finish in this Sunday's race will ensure Antonelli becomes the sport's youngest world champion at 20 years old - breaking Sebastian Vettel's record by three years. Should Antonelli not score any points on Sunday, he will still be world champion if his Mercedes team-mate George Russell or Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton don't win the race. messages.text: McCullum: Brook one of best tactical captains I've come across

metadata.summary: Brendon McCullum called Harry Brook "one of the best tactical captains I've ever come across" after England ended a tough ODI tri-series with a consolation win over Sri Lanka in Lahore.
metadata.content: England head coach Brendon McCullum hails captain Harry Brook after tourists end ODI tri-series with consolation win | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England head coach Brendon McCullum hails captain Harry Brook after tourists end ODI tri-series with consolation win England boss Brendon McCullum talks Harry Brook's leadership, Adil Rashid's omission and the lessons learned as tourists earn victory at last in ODI tri-series; after missing out on the final, McCullum's men now focused on white-ball tour of Australia in November (three ODIs, five T20s) Thursday 29 October 2026 18:29, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player England head coach Brendon McCullum opens up on his side's performances throughout the ODI tri-series as they failed to make the final Brendon McCullum called Harry Brook "one of the best tactical captains I've ever come across" after England ended a tough ODI tri-series with a consolation win over Sri Lanka in Lahore. England lost their first three matches after a botched run chase against Pakistan was followed by failing to defend a total of 429 against Sri Lanka and then suffering another defeat to Pakistan as the hosts reached a target of 242 despite having been 154-9. Brook's side looked in danger of a fourth loss from four when Pavan Rathnayake scored his second hundred against England in as many matches on Thursday but they eventually bowled Sri Lanka out for 331 as their opponents pursued a target of 387. messages.text: Arsenal fail with appeal against Dowman's red card

metadata.summary: Arsenal have failed in their appeal against Max Dowman's red card in the defeat to League Two Fleetwood Town.
metadata.content: Max Dowman: Arsenal's appeal against teenager's red card in Fleetwood Town defeat rejected | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Max Dowman: Arsenal's appeal against teenager's red card in Fleetwood Town defeat rejected Max Dowman was sent off for kicking out at Harrison Neal after a heavy tackle during Arsenal's Carabao Cup defeat to Fleetwood Town on Tuesday; 16-year-old's reaction was adjudged to be violent conduct, meaning a three-game suspension Thursday 29 October 2026 18:55, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Max Dowman was sent off in Arsenal's Carabao Cup tie with Fleetwood Town Arsenal have failed in their appeal against Max Dowman's red card in the defeat to League Two Fleetwood Town. Dowman was dismissed in the second half for violent conduct after kicking out at Fleetwood's Harrison Neal following a heavy challenge, before Arsenal were knocked out of the Carabao Cup on penalties. The 16-year-old will now miss Arsenal's next three domestic matches against Liverpool, Hull and Newcastle following the FA's decision to uphold the ban. In a statement an FA spokesperson said an independent comission dismissed Arsenal's claims of "wronfgul dismissal and excessive punishment". Sky Sports News reported Carrick and Fernandes held clear-the-air talks on Tuesday. messages.text: Alcaraz battles into Vienna Open quarter-finals

metadata.summary: Carlos Alcaraz was forced to work hard to reach the quarter-finals of the Vienna Open, as the world No 3 was taken to a dramatic second-set tiebreak by Nikoloz Basilashvili, before he sealed a 6-1 7-6 (13-11) victory.
metadata.content: Vienna Open: Carlos Alcaraz survives tiebreak scare against Nikoloz Basilashvili as Daniil Medvedev beats Cameron Norrie | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Vienna Open: Carlos Alcaraz survives tiebreak scare against Nikoloz Basilashvili as Daniil Medvedev beats Cameron Norrie Carlos Alcaraz outlasted Nikoloz Basilashvili in a second-set tiebreak to book his place in the third round of the Vienna Open; Daniil Medvedev was taken to a third set tiebreak by Cameron Norrie; watch live the Vienna Open live on Sky Sports Thursday 29 October 2026 18:54, UK Image: Carlos Alcaraz booked his place in the quarter-finals of the Vienna Open on Thursday Carlos Alcaraz was forced to work hard to reach the quarter-finals of the Vienna Open, as the world No 3 was taken to a dramatic second-set tiebreak by Nikoloz Basilashvili, before he sealed a 6-1 7-6 (13-11) victory. The Spaniard has now qualified for the 60th quarter-final in his ATP Tour career and will face Tommy Paul in the last eight. Alcaraz raced to a commanding lead in the opening set, hitting nine winners before Basilashvili hit back in the second, responding to an early break from the Spaniard before saving two break points to force the tiebreak. messages.text: McDermott: England face 'unique task' to progress and can't get distracted

metadata.summary: Brian McDermott has warned his England side not to chase the points as they look to keep their slim Rugby League World Cup hopes alive with a big win against Papua New Guinea.
metadata.content: Rugby League World Cup: England's Brian McDermott admits side face 'unique task' to progress and can't get distracted | Rugby League News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Rugby League World Cup: England's Brian McDermott admits side face 'unique task' to progress and can't get distracted England head coach Brian McDermott speaks to the media on Thursday, as his side seek to avoid historic Rugby League World Cup pool stage exit; England face Papua New Guinea in their final pool fixture on Friday (9.05am kick-off), knowing they need a big win to keep semi-final hopes alive Thursday 29 October 2026 11:13, UK Image: England head coach Brian McDermott spoke to media on Thursday as his side seek to avoid a historic first World Cup pool-stage exit Brian McDermott has warned his England side not to chase the points as they look to keep their slim Rugby League World Cup hopes alive with a big win against Papua New Guinea. England are up against it in their bid to make it through to the semi-finals after they lost 30-12 to Tonga in their opening game. They must beat Papua New Guinea in their final pool game in Woollongong on Friday and then wait until Sunday, when they need Tonga to beat Samoa, upon whom England must also make up a 68-point deficit. That means tries will be the order of the day against Papua New Guinea but McDermott, who saw his side beat France 82-0 in their second game , has called for patience.
